all_contenders.reason: Maps for absolute control jumping from the inside rail stall 1 on the Devonport synthetic. Drops down to a featherweight 54.0kg with apprentice claim. With primary pace competition scratched, canonical style E takes full advantage of the Spreyton inside rail speed bias.
